summary: Applied all four blocking spec review repairs: runtime-log retrieval self-selection, no-flow retrieval, finalize-cleanup metadata timing, and report show failure finalization.

items.title: runtime-log retrieval can select its own just-opened block
items.rationale: Excluded flow get runtime-log from automatic runtime log block creation and required latest non-runtime-log selection.
items.evidence: spec.json scope.in[0], requirements R1/R9, clarifications now state flow get runtime-log is exempt and selects latest non-runtime-log block.

items.title: no-flow logs have no retrieval contract
items.rationale: Added no-flow default retrieval behavior for flow get runtime-log when no active flow exists.
items.evidence: spec.json R9 and acceptance criteria now require reading .tmp/logs/no-flow.log by default without an active flow.

items.title: finalize-cleanup metadata timing is unresolved
items.rationale: Excluded finalize-cleanup from step runtimeLog metadata while keeping runtime output logging for the command itself.
items.evidence: spec.json R6, clarifications, and T-2 implementation notes now name finalize-cleanup as excluded from step metadata due cleanup timing.

items.title: report show failure bypasses dispatcher finalization
items.rationale: Added a requirement and acceptance criterion that report show failures must return or throw through dispatcher handling rather than process.exit.
items.evidence: spec.json R13 and T-2 acceptance now require closed report show failure blocks with exitCode.
